goals.3: Describing a flat: hell, ruhig, nett, neu
dialog.0.de.0.n: Was für ein(e) …? = What kind of …?
grammar.0.title: Adjective after ein-: Nominativ and Akkusativ
grammar.0.note: Remember: ein has no ending (m Nom., n Nom./Akk.), so the adjective shows the gender with -er / -es. Everywhere else it is -e or -en.
grammar.1.title: Dativ: the adjective always ends in -en
grammar.1.note: In the Dativ it is almost always -en: einem kleinen, einer kleinen, netten. The plural noun takes -n in the Dativ.
grammar.2.title: Useful adjectives for describing a flat
grammar.2.note: Predicate: „Die Wohnung ist hell“ — with no ending (after the verb).
